integrity: For every width and separation, the proof enumerates residues modulo a power of two and proves all attainable valuations at the at most two high-valuation positions. Exact parity correlation depends only on the parity of the quotient displacement, proving periodicity under a two-power shift. Standalone code independently checks arithmetic and finite factors. Infinite validity follows from the proof, not finite extrapolation.
scientific_limitations: The stated period is a valid universal period, not a proved least period. The pair bound is an upper bound, not a sharp formula. The argument is specific to the period-doubling word. The full text of the earlier ordinary-boundary article by Guo, Lü, and Wen was not recovered, posing a residual originality risk primarily for width one.
title: Pure periodicity of all extended boundary sequences of the period-doubling word
